limitations: Header validity does not establish pixel payload integrity or release authenticity.
Header associations are encoding/provenance diagnostics, not evidence of CNN reliance or compression causality.
No counterfactual re-encoding was performed; matched re-encoding would be a separate controlled intervention.
Support contains genuine examples only, so within-support class separation is undefined.
No omitted/excluded/full-corpus population claim is made.
Approximate luminance estimates are not recovered encoder quality; exact IJG candidates refer to available complete tables.
No model training, prediction outcomes, target thresholds or label-driven membership changes.

method.quantization_table_storage: Lossless signature-keyed inventory; each header row references its complete table dictionary.
